radarReports.title: The State of Cloud Native Development in China Report
radarReports.summary: Survey-based look at China's cloud native ecosystem — an estimated 1.75M cloud native developers, including 400K working on cloud native AI — and how cloud native infrastructure supports AI teams moving from experimentation to production inference.

radarReports.title: The CNCF Technology Radar Report: Workflow Orchestration, App Delivery and Security & Policy Management
radarReports.summary: Survey of 400+ developers on which workflow orchestration, application delivery, and security & policy management tools are most trusted for maturity, usefulness, and reliability, and how they're moving from experimentation to production.

radarReports.title: CNCF Tech Radar
radarReports.summary: Survey of 300+ developers on which AI inference engines, ML orchestration frameworks, and agentic AI platforms are leading adoption in cloud native environments, and why.

radarReports.title: Tech Radar: Observability Technologies & API Management and Dev Experience
radarReports.summary: Survey of 320+ cloud native developers (Q1 2025) on their experience with observability technologies and with developer-experience and API-management platform tools.

radarReports.title: CNCF Technology Landscape Radar – Japanese translation

radarReports.title: CNCF Technology Landscape Radar
